main_result.result: Moved durable LaunchCapability verification in front of score generation. A score-producing callable receives a deterministic attempt_id bound to capability/block/slot/request-binding, and its ScoreResult is integrity-bound and can enter SLOT preparation only after request/attempt/capability revalidation.
main_result.stress: Wrong block, wrong slot, tampered capability and stale-after-CLOSE launches were rejected before the scorer was called; scorer-call count was zero for all invalid cases. Tampered results and wrong request bindings were rejected before SLOT preparation. Repeated identical capability/slot/request inputs produced the same attempt_id.

measurement_validity_rules: Authorization must precede score generation, not merely score persistence, or invalid work can reveal an outcome before the scientific gate.
Attempt identity must bind the exact durable capability, block, slot and immutable request fingerprint.
A result that was valid at launch can become stale before persistence; SLOT persistence must recheck the live durable capability and fail closed.
An attempt_id is not sufficient stochastic replay control unless the scorer actually uses it to fix all relevant RNG/runtime inputs or an equivalent canonical-result verification exists.

Without a durable pre-compute attempt reservation, concurrent duplicate authorized launches for one slot can still create a choose-among-retries channel if their stochastic outputs differ before the first result is durably committed.
The wrapper is a structural non-adversarial boundary; active runtime wiring is required because historical low-level modules remain importable for reproducibility.
frontier: Add a durable one-attempt reservation before score generation, bound to capability/block/slot/request digest, so exactly one statistical attempt identity can be active for a slot and duplicate launches fail before scorer work.
Integrate reservation with the concrete file writer and define recovery after crash between reservation durability, scorer completion and SLOT durability without permitting choose-the-best reruns.
Byte-execute gate/writer/score wrapper against exact production durable adapter/V3/K-guard siblings in a repository-local runtime.
For stochastic scorers, verify attempt_id actually determines all sampling/runtime inputs or require canonical-result verification before evidence admission.
Extend the same durable acknowledgement discipline to CLOSE and reporting exposure.
exact_next_action: Implement a durable ATTEMPT reservation ledger keyed by capability_digest + block_id + slot_id + request_binding_digest. Reservation must be append+fsync acknowledged before scorer invocation; duplicate/conflicting reservation attempts fail closed; crash after reservation but before SLOT must recover the same immutable attempt_id and must not authorize a different stochastic attempt unless an explicit fail-closed unresolved policy is chosen.
